Commentary.Commentary: Right. So Scotland stay third in the points table. They have a few ifs and buts going their way but they need to win their final game against Netherlands first. That is on Saturday. Friday, 25th October, 2019, sees plenty of matches televised - PNG-Singapore at 10 am local (0600 GMT), followed by the Kenya-Namibia clash at 2.10 pm local (1000 GMT) - both in Dubai. Then in the evening, we witness the Canada-Oman encounter from Abu Dhabi, at 7.30 pm local (1530 GMT). Join us for all the action. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Scotland captain, Kyle Coetzer, says that cricket is not an exact science, so you do not always play the way you want to. Expects tougher teams to come in their way. Looks back at the loss to Singapore and praises them but eventually praises his own team for turning up tonight. Admits that the gap between the top and bottom teams is closing as they keep playing with sides who are improving continuously and rapidly. Praises his batsmen for piling on the runs in the game. On their final match against Netherlands, Coetzer is happy to take the batting confidence and also the spinners choking the opposition, which would be welcome in that game. Hopes to be on the better side of the net run rate. On them playing their first night match this tournament, Kyle says that this is much better than playing in the afternoon heat.

Bermuda skipper, Rodney Trott feels that Scotland played really well, appreciating the innings from Munsey and MacLeod. On Bermuda's takeaways from the tournament, Trott feels that his team played really well tonight and believes that they will take a lot of positives. Guarantees to come hard on Saturday as well and give their best. Is amazed to be broadcast on TV and thanks the fans for coming all the way from Bermuda to support them. Hopes to get a W in their final game.

CALUM MACLEOD IS THE MAN OF THE MATCH. On his blistering knock, MacLeod says that after the game against Namibia, he felt that he should start to score with more intent and it paid off here. On Munsey's knock, Calum says that the more Munsey played, the better MacLeod got in his innings. On getting 200 to defend, Calum says that once that score was reached, he felt it was enough as Scotland have plenty of decent bowlers. Hopes to win their next game against Netherlands as well.

A few hours ago, we witnessed a batting blitzkrieg from Scotland as George Munsey and Calum MacLeod demolished the Bermuda bowlers. The duo scored 125 runs combined in just 78 balls, with 12 fours and 5 sixes. Here is one of them, talking to Alan Wilkins.

Scotland did have plenty of cushion for the bowlers. But they could have done better. They started well, with Mark Watt and Safyaan Sharif taking the wickets but then, lost it in the middle overs. Hamza Tariq was excellent and it was his introduction which stabilized the proceedings. The Scots need to improve this particular area as their next game is against the Dutch who are way better than Bermuda.

Not enough firepower in Bermuda's batting. Delray Rawlins and Kamau Leverock showed glimpses of the talent in this team, perhaps something to look forward to, in the future but nothing much to chew from the others.

Excellent fightback by Bermuda. 205 is never a small total to chase but they fought hard, thanks to fine knocks from Rawlins and Leverock. This loss means that THEY CANNOT QUALIFY for the WT20 2020, but they can keep their heads high after this game.
Outside off, Leverock swings but misses. SCOTLAND WIN BY 46 RUNS!
Full and outside off, driven through mid on for a run.
On middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Down the leg side, Kamau misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
SIX! SPANKED! Goodness me, that is some power. Short and outside off, Leverock gets down and swings it miles over mid-wicket!
FOUR! Full and around off, Leverock gets across to paddle and does so nicely, getting it over short fine leg.
That is an excellent stop. Full and down the leg side, flicked through fine leg but short fine leg dives to his right to stop it.
Short again, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
A slower bouncer, around middle, Kamau misses his pull.
Short in length, pulled wide of long on for a couple.
FOUR! That is so good. Full and outside off, Leverock changes stance, gets down on one knee and switch hits this over point! Good shot, good reward.
Backs away down the leg side and Evans fires a yorker around leg stump. Leverock just about manages to dug it out.
Alasdair Evans to bowl the 19th over. 3-0-28-1 so far.
The batsman has taken the aerial route and played that over the covers. One run added to the total.
Outside off, Kamau swings hard but misses.
FOUR! Off the top edge. Short and outside off, Leverock swings hard but gets a top edge over short fine leg.

RUN OUT MISSED. Full and outside off, Leverock hits this down to long off and calls for two. However, his partner is happy with the single and takes the second pretty late. Mark Watt runs in from long on and fires a throw at the bowler's end but Sharif misses it. Smith was nowhere in the frame.
Exactly in the middle. Full on middle, Smith lifts this high in the air. Long on and long off race across but it lands right in between. A single taken.
Full on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Safyaan Sharif is back on. 2-0-13-2 so far.
On middle, lofted down to long on for a run.
A short ball, around off, Leverock comes down the track and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, this is reverse swept straight to point.
Full again, driven for a quick single this time to cover.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
A yorker on middle, dug out back to the bowler. Berrington collects and has a shy at the striker's end, missing them.
WIDE. Another one down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Richie Berrington comes on again. 3-0-41-1 so far.
Full and outside off, pushed down to long off for a run.
Once again he gets across the stumps, the ball is fired on middle, Kamau somehow gets his sweep to connect with the ball to send it to square leg for a single.
Comes down the track and hits it back to the bowler.

WIDE. Fired miles outside off, Leverock gets across and then tries to sweep but misses. The keeper first makes a brilliant take to his right, then waits to see whether Leverock's foot goes up in the air. But it does not.
Quicker and shorter outside off, dabbed to short third man for a single.
Around off, Smith looks to defend but gets a bit of an inside edge.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Mark Watt again. 3-0-13-2 so far.
Around middle, chipped uppishly, just wide of the bowler towards long on for a single.
SIX! SMOKED! Tremendous power. Full and outside off, Leverock backs away, then gets down and slams it straight back over the bowler's head! This bloke should have come earlier to bat.
Tossed up outside off, SS looks to drive again but the bat hits the ground and he misses. The ball hits the keeper's pads and goes to short third man. A bye taken.
Full and outside off, Sinclair looks to drive but is beaten.
Outside off, blocked towards cover.
Full and outside off, Smith looks to drive cum defend but misses.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Sinclair Smith, one of the two remaining batsmen, comes out.

OUT! LBW! Gun-barrel straight. Slower delivery from Berrington, on a length outside off, Trott just tries to work it around the corner on the leg side, but is early into his shot. He misses and is hit on the pads. Berrington appeals and the slow death is raised by the umpire.
Dropped short now, pulled through mid-wicket for one.
SIX! SMASH! Boy, that is huge. Full and around off, Leverock gets down and mows a slog, miles over mid-wicket!
Outside off, tapped to point for a run.
Around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Rodney Trott comes on to bat now. Richie Berrington comes on to bowl again as well. 2-0-31-0 so far. Time for some tidiness.

OUT! Plumb LBW! Dead duck. Full and around off, the arm ball, Okera Bascome looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. The bowler appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Crashing into the stumps. All the three Bascomes are done for the night.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad.
Down the leg side, Bascome looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.

How has that missed the stumps?Full and outside off, Bascome looks to run it down to third man but the ball hits the back leg and flies up. It shoots straight into the helmet if the keeper who moves away. They appeal for LBW but it is turned down.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Hamza Tahir returns. 2-0-18-1 so far.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Around off, Bascome looks to cut but the ball sneaks in, takes the inside edge and goes to short fine leg.
Full and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Landed outside off, dabbed to short third man.
Full and outside off, driven towards cover.
Okera Bascome walks in at number 8, replacing Rawlins.

OUT! Caught. Pooran is gone now. Oops... wrong man? Boy, this lad plays so similar to the way Pooran plays, that he might be christened as Delray Pooran. A low full toss, around middle, Rawlins gets down and plays the slog sweep but does not connect it too well. Does not get height either and Safyaan Sharif takes a good low catch. Rawlins is on the ground, struggling to get up and is perhaps suffering from cramps. End of a fine knock.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single. 9 runs and a wicket from the over, 12/2 in the last 2.
Short and outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Kamau Leverock walks in at number 7, replacing Onais Bascome.

OUT! Caught! The short stuff gets him this time. Outside off, Onais Bascome looks to pull but mistimes it towards short mid-wicket where the fielder takes a simple catch, running to his right. George Munsey it is. At this rate, Rawlins is going to be stranded of partners.
SIX! STUPENDOUS! He is batting without helmet and that perhaps prompts the bowler to go short. He does but Onais pulls this over wide long on!
And again. Another play and a miss. Back of a length outside off, Onais looks to run this down to third man but misses.
On a length outside off, Bascome looks to run it down to third man but misses.
Alasdair Evans has come back on. 2-0-19-0 so far.

Full and outside off, Bascome pushes it towards long off and gets off the mark with a single. Just 3 runs and a wicket from the over, a bit of a relief for Scotland, after going for 31 in the last 2 overs.
Onias Bascome comes out to the middle now.
OUT! BOWLED! Mark Watt strikes gold. Full and straight, Douglas attempts a wild hoick against the line and misses. The ball goes straight through the gap between bat and pad and hits the stumps.
Short and outside off, punched towards short extra cover.
Walks across his stumps and the ball is fired down leg. The batsman adjusts well and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Mark Watt now. 1-0-9-0 so far.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Around off, Douglas looks to cut but mistimes it towards point.
Another short one, pulled down to long on for a single.

FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries! Short and outside off, Rawlins rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket. Michael Leask runs to his left from wide long on and dives but can do nothing about the boundary!
FOUR! SMASH! Rawlins is putting on a show here. Full and outside off, the leftie reaches out and sweeps it through mid-wicket!
FOUR! Nicely done! Full and around middle, Rawlins gets down and reverse sweeps it over point for a boundary!
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run. 17 from the over!
The ball is lost. A replacement ball comes out.
SIX! Another big one! Full and outside off, Rawlins gets down and sends this sailing over long on! And where is the ball?
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The camera pans onto Tom Sole. The ICC has come up with a list of bowlers whose bowling action has been found illegal. Tom Sole is one of those.
WIDE. Well outside off, Douglas throws his bat at it but misses.
Around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! STUPENDOUS! Shades of Nicholas Pooran in that shot. Full and outside off, Rawlins gets down and mows a slog sweep miles over mid-wicket!

That stayed low. A length ball outside off, coming in sharply, Rawlins swivels to pull but the ball shoots beneath the bat and hits him on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire moves away. Going down leg. A leg bye taken.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Around middle, Douglas chips this over a leaping short mid-wicket for one.
Full and around off, swept through square leg for a run.
Around off, watchfully pushed to the off side for a single.
New batsman is the 32-year old Allan Douglas. Did not play in the last game.

OUT! LBW! Hamza has struck on his very second ball. That is very plumb. Bascome is very unhappy but not too sure why. He did not pick the line, nor the length, walked just straight across and missed the flick. The ball pitched outside off and skid through, hitting him on the pads. Crashing into the stumps.
Full and around middle, flicked through long on, uppishly, for a single.
Hamza Tahir comes on to bowl. 23 years of age, left-arm spin, mightily effective. He is a cousin of Majid Haq and another cousin of Omar Hussain, another Scottish international.
Full and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket. 15 from the over, 27 from the last 2! 56/2 at the end of the Powerplay, Scotland were 37/1 at this stage.
ANOTHER WIDE. 9th of the innings already. Down the leg side again, flick shot missed.
Around middle, flicked uppishly, wide of long on. Bascome wants the second and charges down but is sent back.
Works this through mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, Bascome misses his flick. Struggling with his line, is Berrington.
Flicks this through square leg for a single.
SIX! That is some talented shot. 10 from the first two balls. Full and around middle, Rawlins swings it over mid-wicket!
FOUR! SLAUGHTERED! Welcome into the attack, Berry! A loosener, short and around off, Rawlins pulls it through square leg and gets a boundary!
Richie Berrington comes on to bowl.
FOUR! Nice flick to end the over! Full and on the pads, Bascome flicks it through square leg and the ball races to the mid-wicket boundary! 12 from the over!
A short ball, pulled through square leg for a single.
WIDE. A bouncer, bowled way too high, ducked under.
Around middle, flicked straight to square leg.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. One run added to the total.
FOUR! SLAP! Short and outside off, Bascome pulls it through square leg and gets a boundary!
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Outside off, Bascome plays inside the line and misses.
Delray Rawlins walks in at number 4, replacing Fray.

OUT! Stunning caught and bowled! Excellent, simply marvellous from Sharif. Full and around middle, Fray looks to flick but gets a leading edge which flies in the air. It seems like the ball will evade the bowler but Sharif flies to his left, sticks out his hand and the ball sticks! Terrific attempt.
Short and outside off, Bascome steers it behind point towards third man for a single.
WIDE. Another wide, this time for a bouncer down the leg side.
Outside off, played towards point.
Around middle and off, tucked through square leg for a run.
Landed outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Around off, pushed back down the track.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, Bascome misses his flick.
Outside off, played straight to point.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, a flash and a miss.
FOUR! A short ball, outside off, Fray pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Full and outside off, Bascome swings hard and gets a thick outside edge which flies down to third man. A single taken.
Terryn Fray comes in at number 3, replacing Stovell. Alasdair Evans comes on to bowl as well.

OUT! BOWLED! Chopped on. A length ball outside off, Stovell comes down the track and swings wildly, getting nowhere near the pitch of the ball. It comes on much slower than his anticipation, takes the inside edge and hits the stumps.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a single.
Outside off, tapped towards point for a single.

FOUR! Not cleanly timed, but he will get a boundary. A length ball outside off, Stovell backs away and looks to go over cover but the slow pitch makes the ball come even slower. He skews it over cover but clears the infield and gets a boundary.
Around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Safyaan Sharif to bowl from the other end.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
FOUR! A short ball, around off, Stovell backs away and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Full and around off, pushed down the track.
Around off, Dion backs away to cut but gets a thick inside edge which drops down.
Full and down the leg side, Stovell misses his flick and misses. No wide this time.
ANOTHER WIDE. This is pitched further outside leg, Bascome misses his flick and the keeper misses it too, with the ball deflecting to short fine leg. A bye taken.
WIDE. Fired down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Full and outside off, Stovell works it through square leg for a single.
We are back for the chase. The Scotland players are out in the middle. Dion Stovell and Oronde Bascome will open the batting for Bermuda. Mark Watt will start the proceedings for Scotland.
